basis: Source-only bounded arithmetic review of hash-bound 6.0 and 5.1 caller/helper fragments. Does not use CVE labels for detection and does not upgrade product status.

6.0.source_bound_arithmetic: argsSize is size_t from args->GetSize(); dataListSize is int(argsSize+flowbufSize); curIndex is int. Fixed branches guard flowbuffer while writes with curIndex < dataListSize; ordinary argument branch writes remain unguarded and are preserved.

5.1.source_bound_arithmetic: argsSize is size_t from args->GetSize(); dataListSize is int(argsSize+flowbufSize); curIndex is int. Fixed branches guard flowbuffer while writes with curIndex < dataListSize; ordinary argument branch writes remain unguarded and are preserved.

derived_bound: Let N=argsSize and F=flowbufSize. The exact GetFlowbufCount helper loops i from 0 to MAX_ENTRIES-1 and increments count only for a contiguous nonzero-length prefix, so 0<=F<=10. Each successful flowbuffer insertion increments curIndex once and advances flowbufIndex; each args loop iteration increments curIndex once, including the null-value branch. Subject to no arithmetic wrap and exact one-to-one source/helper semantics, before argument i the mathematical cursor is <= i+F < N+F.
unresolved_obligations: The vector constructor capacity expression is argsSize + static_cast<size_t>(flowbufSize); prove no size_t overflow for N+F.
The local dataListSize stores argsSize + flowbufSize into int; range and conversion behavior are not proven.
curIndex is int; prove it cannot overflow during up to N+F increments.
The pinned target repo tree does not include the referenced CEF public API header path needed to bind CefListValue::GetSize maximum/range; no product build profile was found.
The source does not provide a product-level bound on N or an attacker-controlled input limit.
decision: Do not suppress six ordinary-argument candidates. Their source sites exist in both vulnerable and fixed versions, outside the three patched flowbuffer while loops. Preserve them as unresolved index/capacity arithmetic candidates; they are not evidence that the disclosed missing while-loop guard persists.
